csv_scope_of_work: The City of Nashua, NH is seeking qualification submittals for the provision of Architectural and Engineering Services for a proposed Richard LaRose Way improvement. The selected firm will be expected to work in a highly collaborative manner with stakeholders to develop and define a final inspirational and functional design based on concept designs created for Activate Nashua, help define a construction budget (in conjunction with an owner s project manager and construction manager both hired separately for the West Pearl Street Streetscape improvement project, and concurrently with the City), create construction documents while also providing construction administration services during the physical construction phase/effort
